critique.evidence: Frame delivery is stable: arena sampling stayed near 14–16.3 ms with worst frames at 16.8 ms, and all viewport runs reported a 0 long-frame ratio. However, standard mode showed 0 active animations, 0 transition elements, and 0 changed elements at desktop, tablet, and mobile, so no actual motion sequence is proven.
